#+title: Consumer-owned Org Element queries

* Active reviews
:PROPERTIES:
:QUERY_ID: customer.active-review
:END:

#+begin_src scheme :org-elements
(org-elements headline
              (all-of (property todo-type "todo")
                      (property-contains source-title "Review"))
              (descendant-of scope))
#+end_src

* Cited evidence
:PROPERTIES:
:QUERY_ID: customer.cited-evidence
:END:

#+begin_src scheme :org-elements
(org-elements citation-reference (property key "doe2020"))
#+end_src
